claims: Several small, non-threatening asteroids are frequently passing near Earth in early 2026.
NASA is tracking asteroid 2026 EG1 at safe distances.
NASA is tracking asteroid 2026 CR2 at safe distances.
A bus-sized asteroid passed within 198,000 miles of Earth on March 12, 2026, posing no danger.
NASA finds no significant impact risks within the next 100 years.
